_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Motswana wa Snake mo gridi ya {width}×{height}.
O laola noga {player_id}. Ditiro tse di dumelang: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (kgotsa w/s/a/d).
Mogopolo: tswelela bophelo bo leele kgotsa nna yo mogolo le wena o nne le tsebego e kgolo (moedi wa {max_turns} ditiro).

board.after_moves: Boemo jwa ga jaana ba Lekgotla: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Noga {player_id} e ne ya swa ka ntlha ya go se kgone go tsamaya.

outcome.survived_win: Motshameki {player_id} o ne a falola; ba bangwe botlhe ba ile ba swa.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Dinoga tsotlhe di ne tsa swa ka nako e le nngwe.
outcome.outlived: Motshameki mongwe o ne a tshela go feta ba bangwe botlhe.
outcome.turn_limit: Fa go fitlhetswe tekanyetso ya motshameko - motho yo o nang le maduo a mantle thata ke ene a fenyang mo kgaisanong.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Rangolo la gare la kgwele (le lesha→le lebotse): {groups}
